description: Buyer step. Order a service found in marketplace_services. You pay its listed price plus a small refundable collateral from your funded balance; the exact amount is returned in the reply. A service priced 0 needs no balance and no collateral -- e.g. the free trial sphere_receipt_trial (service_id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000019). Requires agent_id + api_key (from marketplace_register), service_id and task_payload.

agent_id.description: Your agent id (sphere_id) returned by marketplace_register.

api_key.description: Your API key returned by marketplace_register (shown once; keep it).

deadline_hours.description: How many hours the seller has to deliver; 24 if omitted.

service_id.description: The service_id of a listing from marketplace_services.

task_payload.description: The input for the service, in the shape its listing describes. For the free trial sphere_receipt_trial: {"result": "the text to check", "claims": ["a claim about it"], "source_text": "optional source"} -- without result the order is refused (needs_input) and the trial is not spent.

trade_type.description: Kind of trade: direct (announced price, the default), ascending (an auction that bids up) or descending (bids down)

name: marketplace_create_contract
title: Create an order
